passed: POST /api/tools/seed-test-data (admin): returns ok, tools_creadas=20, tecnicos_creados=5*ciudades, bodegas_totales>=ciudades
GET /api/tools/warehouses returns array of {id,nombre,ciudad,email}; no _id leak
POST /api/tools/assignments/batch destination_type=technician: creates assignments, batch_id returned, PDF downloadable (%PDF header), emails handled
POST /api/tools/assignments/batch destination_type=warehouse: creates warehouse assignment; GET /api/tools/warehouses/{id}/tools reflects new tools
POST /api/tools/returns: closes tech assignments, opens warehouse assignments in tech's city, PDF downloadable, tools visible at target warehouse

POST /api/tools/transfers rejects tool not present in source warehouse with 400
GET /api/tools/transfers lists transfers (no _id, no pdf_hex leak)
Frontend login (aeortega/admin123) OK; ToolsLayout sidebar shows nav-devoluciones and nav-traspasos data-testids
Frontend /herramientas/asignaciones: dest-tech-btn & dest-wh-btn toggle correctly; assign-tech-select and assign-wh-select render based on toggle
Frontend /herramientas/devoluciones: ret-tech-select renders 4 techs with assignments; selecting a tech reveals ret-check-{code} items (3 found)

Frontend /herramientas/traspasos: trs-from-select shows 9 warehouses; trs-to-select, trs-submit-btn present; 'Traspasos recientes' history table renders existing rows (Ambato->Quito, Ambato->Cuenca from earlier smoke test)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2211 lines — recommend splitting the tools module (~1000 lines) into a separate router file for maintainability (e.g. routers/tools.py).

Duplicate HTML email body construction across create_assignments_batch/create_return_batch/create_transfer (~40 lines each). Extract a _build_tools_email_html(header, subject, tools, footer_color) helper to reduce DRY violations.
PDFs are stored as hex in Mongo (pdf_hex). For a growing dataset this is inefficient — consider GridFS or filesystem storage (or at least Binary type).

In /api/tools/reports/current the technician_id query does not filter warehouse assignments before applying {destination_type: {$ne: 'warehouse'}} redundancy — minor; also the endpoint ignores an optional warehouse_id filter which could be useful.
AssignmentBatchIn allows empty tool_ids list — backend does not reject at the schema level. Add min_items=1 to Pydantic or explicit 400.

TraspasosPage.jsx sends tool_ids using items from /warehouses/{id}/tools where each item exposes `tool_id: t.id` (actual uuid). Naming is confusing because in the tools collection `tool_id` is the human code. Consider renaming warehouse-tools payload field to `id` to avoid confusion for future devs.
seed_data_creation: Called POST /api/tools/seed-test-data once during backend tests: +20 tools, +5 techs per city (9 cities). Some assignments/returns/transfers were made as part of tests (leftover data harmless for subsequent runs).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new tools features pass backend + frontend smoke. Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_tools_features.py can be re-run with `pytest backend/tests/test_tools_features.py -v`. Tests are idempotent-ish but add data each run; seed endpoint accumulates.
